text:
elaine: Quick note from today's onboarding lab: the Node quickstart sample is overwhelming our tenant quotas when users page through historical embeddings. 429s pile up fast.
viktor: saw that too. root cause seems to be twofold: the sample fires many concurrent page calls and the client retry backoff is immediate/no-jitter.
elainE: typo :) elaine: oops :)
jun: can you paste the snippet?
elaine: it's doing this: ```js
// dumb parallel paging
const pages = await Promise.all(pageTokens.map(t => client.embeddings.page({ cursor: t })))
```
viktor: classic. Also the JS SDK doesn't expose the internal limiter we have in the runtime so sample authors can't opt into a shared token-bucket. Python's SDK exposes a public RateLimiter class which makes this easier.
jun: SDK parity gap noted. proposal: export a small `rateLimiter.create({permitsPerSec, burst})` from JS SDK root and mark stable. fallback: sample can default to `p-limit(3)` until SDK change lands.
support-bot: FYI - a support case was opened by a customer who hit this in prod and assumed our quota was misconfigured.
elaine: onboarding friction = bad signal. customers blame us instead of sample app. we should update quickstart and add a "Concurrency & 429" troubleshooting section.
viktor: auth-wise there's also a refresh race: when an expiring token triggers refresh, several in-flight requests get 401, then naive retry replays and duplicates work. We should singleflight the refresh and/or queue requests until token is rotated.
jun: implement `auth.onceRefresh()` that returns existing in-flight refresh promise if present. tiny change but huge effect.
elaine: for retries let's standardize on exponential backoff with jitter: `delay = base * 2**attempt * (0.8 + Math.random()*0.4)` and cap at e.g. 2s for client-side before handing off to server-side quota.
viktor: also add per-request headers so support can correlate: `x-rl-window` and `x-client-concurrency`. small instrumentation helps triage.
support-bot: opened internal KB: "Quickstart: handling 429s during pagination" with suggested code and p-limit fallback. link: https://kb.redwood-inference.dev/quickstart-429s
deploy-bot: preview build for quickstart docs available: https://deployments.redwood-inference.dev/pr/520
jun: I'll send a PR for auth.singleflight and small samples patch. viktor: I'll export a thin limiter and add example in README. elaine: I'll update KB and add a checkbox in the quickstart checklist: "If you see 429s, reduce concurrency or use the SDK rateLimiter".
jun: one more idea: sample's pagination helper could expose a `concurrency` arg so apps don't need to change code pattern. e.g. `for await (const page of client.embeddings.paginate({query}, {concurrency: 2})) {}`
elaine: love that API ergonomics. low friction win.
viktor: timeline? small patches could ship this week. I'll pair with jun on the PRs.
elaine: thanks all — this should cut onboarding tickets by a lot. :raised_hands:
